strings.text: The lantern burns as long as someone is waiting.
strings.translation: El farol arde mientras alguien espera.

strings.text: Every evening she comes to the old pier.
strings.translation: Cada tarde ella viene al viejo muelle.

strings.text: So that from the far shore they can see where to row.
strings.translation: Para que desde la otra orilla se vea hacia dónde remar.
